label: late original-phase steps in sequences with a specific prefix (m/h/g/x/w/2/o/0, then 0/b/h/m, then 0/b/f/h)
explanation: Sparse feature (0.03% of steps). 96% of its mass is in the original phase, at the last 1-3 input tokens of long sequences (orig_idx 7-8, L=8-9; rate there is 13-27x baseline). It never fires at t<3 and almost never in the copy phase; a little mass lands on the <DEL> step. Position alone covers 71% of mass but has precision below 1%, so what actually decides whether it fires is which tokens came earlier. Activity rises when the first three originals come from small sets (first token m/h/g/x/w/2/o/0; second 0/b/h/m; third 0/b/f/h) and when the current token is c/y/n/x/t/2. These conjunctions only reach F1 of about 0.18 on dev, so the feature looks like a fine-grained hash of the hidden state that no simple predicate captures. Magnitude: top quartile is concentrated at the last original step with matching prefixes; magnitude was not checked beyond that.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig1=0 (+4.56), orig0=m (+4.45), orig0=h (+4.12), orig0=g (+3.63), orig0=x (+3.61), orig1=h (+3.55). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-4.31), orig_idx=-1 (-2.72), orig2=o (-2.23), prev_tok=1 (-2.15).
